pairs.question: Quid istas potius legam quam Graecas?
pairs.answer: Idem Andriam et Synephebos nec minus Andromacham aut Antiopam aut Epigonos Latinos recipiunt.
pairs.derivation: An objection quoted in direct speech ('Alterum:') as a genuine interrogative (why read these Latin versions rather than the Greek?). The framing tag 'Alterum:' is dropped as narration. The answer is the single immediately following sentence rebutting the objection (the same readers accept Latin versions of Greek plays); it ends at the first full stop. The next sentence ('Quod igitur est eorum ... fastidium, nullum cum sit in versibus?') is a further rhetorical question elaborating the point, so it is cut. The other quoted objections ('Verum melius Graeci.', 'Sed exorietur Thucydides...', 'At loquitur pulchre.') are statements answered by Cicero's own counter-questions, not Q&A pairs, and were dropped.
